name: GEBCO bathymetry (WMS)
note: Sea-floor depth; shows the Sunda and Sahul shelves that joined Sumatra, Java and Borneo to the mainland at low sea level. External service: GetMap pattern from GEBCO's WMS documentation, not testable offline.

name: NASA Blue Marble relief (GIBS tiles)
attribution: Imagery provided by services from NASA GIBS, operated by NASA/GSFC/ESDIS
note: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services WMTS (EPSG:3857, KVP-free REST pattern {layer}/default/{TileMatrixSet}/{z}/{row}/{col}). External service; not testable offline.
